strategy: This is a Bracket 3 build with two Game Changers, no mass land denial, no extra turns, and only a late-game two-card combo; it aims to close from turn six onward through accumulated pressure rather than a fast combo.

research.summary:
1. **Main builds.** [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] is primarily a **wheels deck**: land a draw or discard payoff, then refill everyone’s hand for burst damage. **Group slug** builds lean more on repeatable forced draw for steady damage. **Control/combo** builds use wheels to strip hands or set up a separate finish. The key choice: if you stop opponents from drawing, you also give up your commander’s damage from those draws. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/nekusar-the-mindrazer/wheels?utm_source=openai))

2. **Key cards and engines.** Start with [[Windfall]], [[Wheel of Fortune]], and [[Echo of Eons]] for burst, plus [[Teferi's Puzzle Box]] for repeatable pressure. [[Razorkin Needlehead]], [[Sheoldred, the Apocalypse]], and [[Spiteful Visions]] keep the punishment going when your commander is gone. [[Waste Not]] turns opposing discards into mana, cards, or Zombies; [[Liliana's Caress]] makes the discard half of a wheel hurt even if opponents never redraw. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/nekusar-the-mindrazer/wheels?utm_source=openai))

3. **Common combo lines.**
   - [[Teferi's Puzzle Box]] + [[Narset, Parter of Veils]]: opponents take their normal draw, then bottom their hands and get no replacement cards. It’s a hand lock, not a damage combo. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/nekusar-the-mindrazer/good-stuff/combos?utm_source=openai))
   - [[Niv-Mizzet, Parun]] + [[Curiosity]]: enchant the Dragon and start with a draw. Ping an opponent, draw again, and repeat for as much damage as your remaining library allows. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/nekusar-the-mindrazer/chaos/combos?utm_source=openai))
   - [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] + [[Tainted Strike]] + [[Windfall]]: give your commander infect before the wheel. If the largest discarded hand has at least ten cards and opponents actually draw ten, the damage gives each of them lethal poison from zero. A seven-card wheel alone isn’t lethal from zero. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/nekusar-the-mindrazer/optimized/toolbox/combos?utm_source=openai))

4. **Common mistakes.** Don’t wheel just because you can: without a payoff, you may refill the player who was running out of gas. Don’t cast your commander on curve into open removal if you can wait to protect it or wheel immediately. In faster builds, [[Dragon Mage]] is a reasonable cut because it costs seven mana and has to connect in combat; [[Spellbook]] is another easy cut because it neither advances the plan nor protects it. ([reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/mtg/comments/1why88a/building_nekusar/?utm_source=openai))

5. **Mana base.** Start around **36–37 lands** and prioritize untapped fixing: you need all three colors for your five-mana commander, ideally with mana left for protection or a wheel. Start with [[Command Tower]] and [[Exotic Orchard]]; add [[Xander's Lounge]] for fetchable fixing, but don’t overload on tapped lands. Favor two-mana fixing such as [[Arcane Signet]], [[Talisman of Dominance]], [[Talisman of Creativity]], and [[Talisman of Indulgence]]. If you run [[Razorkin Needlehead]] or [[Niv-Mizzet, Parun]], check your early double-red or triple-blue/triple-red sources rather than relying on colorless ramp. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/nekusar-the-mindrazer/wheels/average-deck?utm_source=openai))

synergies.title: Discard Pays, Drawing Hurts
synergies.explanation: [[Wheel and Deal]] turns the chosen opponents' discards into creatures, mana, or cards through [[Waste Not]], then gives each of those opponents seven draws to trigger [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]]. You get those payoffs at instant speed, though you also discard your own hand.

synergies.title: Bounce, Then Bin
synergies.explanation: Overload [[Cyclonic Rift]] before your turn to return opposing nonland permanents to hand, then cast [[Windfall]] to make opponents discard them before they can rebuild. The swollen hands can raise the draw count for everyone, turning the reset into a burst of damage from [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]].

synergies.title: Every Point Pays
synergies.explanation: Every card an opponent draws from [[Prosperity]] produces a separate 1-damage trigger from [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]], growing [[Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin]] and exiling a card you can play. Each card you draw also triggers [[Psychosis Crawler]], and its simultaneous 1-life loss across all opponents triggers [[Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin]] once per card you draw.

synergies.title: Wheel on Demand
synergies.explanation: [[Swiftfoot Boots]] gives [[Jace's Archivist]] haste to activate immediately and hexproof to help keep the repeatable wheel online. [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] turns each opponent's refill into damage.

synergies.title: The Box Keeps Billing
synergies.explanation: [[Scrawling Crawler]] adds a card to each player's hand on your upkeep, giving [[Teferi's Puzzle Box]] another card to replace if they hold onto it. When both abilities trigger, resolve [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] first so that extra card also gets replaced; every opponent draw costs them 1 damage and 1 life.

synergies.title: Draw, Ping, Bounce
synergies.explanation: Enchant [[Razorkin Needlehead]] with [[Sigil of Sleep]] so its damage can bounce a creature every time that creature's controller draws. [[Scrawling Crawler]] gives you a round of bounce triggers on your upkeep while adding its own life loss.

synergies.title: Nobody Draws for Free
synergies.explanation: [[Scrawling Crawler]] makes everyone draw on your upkeep, and [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] gives everyone another card on their own draw step. [[Psychosis Crawler]] turns your draws into life loss for every opponent, while the other two punish each opponent for their own draws.

synergies.title: Ramp Without the Burn
synergies.explanation: [[Manabarbs]] punishes every player who taps lands for mana, but [[Darksteel Ingot]] and the deck's other mana rocks let you develop your mana without ever tapping a land, so you keep casting wheels and pingers while opponents bleed for theirs.

synergies.title: Triple Tap Tax
synergies.explanation: [[Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]] turns each [[Manabarbs]] trigger into a much harsher punishment, so opponents are squeezed hard every time they tap a land for mana to cast spells or pay attack taxes.

synergies.title: Pay to Attack, Bleed to Tap
synergies.explanation: [[Propaganda]] and [[Collective Restraint]] force attackers to spend mana, and every land tapped to pay that tax bleeds them through [[Manabarbs]], so opponents are damned whether they attack or not.

synergies.title: Indestructible Metalcraft
synergies.explanation: [[Darksteel Ingot]] survives your own [[Starstorm]] and other sweepers, keeping your artifact count high so [[Molten Psyche]] reliably hits metalcraft and burns the table alongside each wheel.

synergies.title: Parasite's Red Rider
synergies.explanation: [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] is a red permanent that turns on [[Kederekt Parasite]], so every extra card an opponent draws during their draw step triggers each damage dealer at once.

synergies.title: Visions of Suffering
synergies.explanation: [[Spiteful Visions]] is a red permanent that enables [[Kederekt Parasite]] and adds an extra draw each draw step; each effect punishes every card drawn.

synergies.title: Needle, Horror, Dreams
synergies.explanation: [[Razorkin Needlehead]] provides the red permanent [[Kederekt Parasite]] needs, and with [[Underworld Dreams]] every opponent draw is punished by each of them.

synergies.title: Crescent Moon Parasite
synergies.explanation: [[Kami of the Crescent Moon]] and [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] each add an extra draw to every draw step, and the latter is red to enable [[Kederekt Parasite]]; each opponent's draw step becomes a pile of damage triggers.

synergies.title: Fetching Without the Burn
synergies.explanation: [[Terramorphic Expanse]] is cracked for a land instead of being tapped to produce mana, so it never turns [[Manabarbs]] against you, and the land it finds arrives tapped, holding off your own payment even longer while opponents bleed for every land they tap.

synergies.title: Basic Types Make the Tax Bite
synergies.explanation: [[Terramorphic Expanse]] searches out basic lands, whose land types count toward the payment [[Collective Restraint]] demands, and [[Propaganda]] stacks on top so attackers must pay for both while [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] keeps pinging.

synergies.title: Double Red Made Easy
synergies.explanation: [[Izzet Guildgate]] plus a red basic found by [[Terramorphic Expanse]] cover the steep red cost of [[Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]], whose boost makes every draw that [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] punishes hurt more.

synergies.title: Helm Turns Nekusar Rack
synergies.explanation: [[Helm of the Ghastlord]] on [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] makes each draw-ping also draw you a card and force that opponent to discard; [[Waste Not]] turns those discards into mana, creatures, or more cards.

synergies.title: Counter Feeds the Punishment
synergies.explanation: [[Arcane Denial]] turns a counter into extra opponent draws, so [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] pings that opponent for each card and your delayed draw can trigger your own draw-payoffs.

synergies.title: Cheap Removal, Free Ping
synergies.explanation: Paying the alternate cost of [[Baleful Mastery]] exiles a threat while making an opponent draw; that draw becomes a [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] ping that satisfies [[Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin]] and exiles a card.

synergies.title: Asymmetric Disaster
synergies.explanation: Kicked [[Molten Disaster]] has split second, and [[Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]] makes its damage to opponents and their creatures larger while leaving your side alone.

original.summary: This deck forces everyone to draw extra cards while [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] and every draw-punisher bleed the table dry. It wins by stacking those pain effects until opponents simply run out of life.
early: Land [[Sol Ring]] or [[Arcane Signet]] so [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] arrives early.
Drop [[Kederekt Parasite]] or [[Underworld Dreams]] to punish draws before your commander lands.
Prefer [[Command Tower]] and [[Exotic Orchard]] over lands that enter tapped.
mid: [[Harmonic Prodigy]] doubles the punishing triggers of your wizard-shaped sources.
[[Teferi's Puzzle Box]] with [[Scrawling Crawler]] turns every draw step into steady life loss.
Hold [[Arcane Denial]] for real threats, since the extra cards it hands out hurt them too.
late: Fire a large [[Prosperity]] or [[Minds Aglow]] to close the game in one burst.
[[Psychosis Crawler]] alongside [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] means each drawn card bleeds everyone.
[[Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]] turns every single-point ping into a much bigger hit.
winConditions: Drain the table with [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] backed by [[Underworld Dreams]] and [[Fate Unraveler]].
[[Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind]] enchanted by [[Helm of the Ghastlord]] draws forever and kills everyone.
A huge [[Blue Sun's Zenith]] or [[Prosperity]] with [[Psychosis Crawler]] out finishes the table.

original.mulligan: Keep three lands, one mana rock, and either [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] or a cheap draw-punisher.
watchOut: [[Manabarbs]] hits you too, so tap lands carefully once it resolves.
Opponents will save removal for [[Underworld Dreams]] and [[Spiteful Visions]].
You hand out cards freely, so fast aggressive decks may race your engine.

optimized.summary: This is a Nekusar draw-punishment deck: you force everyone to draw extra cards while [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] and friends bleed them for each one. You win by stacking those pings and wheel effects until the table dies.
early: Ramp with [[Sol Ring]] and [[Arcane Signet]] so [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] arrives ahead of schedule.
Deploy [[Kederekt Parasite]] or [[Underworld Dreams]] early to tax every draw immediately.
[[Nightscape Familiar]] and [[Talisman of Creativity]] make your blue and red spells cheaper.
mid: Cast [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]], then follow with [[Windfall]] to punish full hands.
[[Waste Not]] converts their forced discards into black mana and Zombie tokens.
[[Teferi's Puzzle Box]] rewrites every draw step and retriggers all your punishers.
late: [[Psychosis Crawler]] and [[Spiteful Visions]] drain the whole table as cards flow.
[[Molten Psyche]] with three artifacts deals massive damage right after a wheel.
[[Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]] makes every point of your red ping hit harder.
winConditions: [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]] plus [[Underworld Dreams]] and forced draws kills everyone.
[[Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind]] enchanted by [[Helm of the Ghastlord]] draws your deck infinitely.
[[Blue Sun's Zenith]] forces enormous draws that each ping through [[Nekusar, the Mindrazer]].
